fusions.name: Wringing the Venom Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A crushing squeeze deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage and 50% more damage for each one used up.

fusions.name: Retched Draught
fusions.desc: Spits drawn poison in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it with a 60% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds, and knocks them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bitter-Leaf Chew
fusions.desc: Removes 2 poison conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Hardened Gut
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.
